items.excerpt: Head coach Steve Tandy says there is a been a big demand on the workload of Wales scrum-half Tomos Williams. The British and Irish Lions number nine again played the full 80 minutes in the 28-21 defeat of Japan with Rebuen Morgan-Williams an unused replacement. Williams has started 12 out of 13 Test matches in the Tandy era and has completed five of those games. "It is a big balance to strike," said Tandy as he prepared his side to face New Zealand in Cardiff on Saturday.
